notes:
Blast Yard 0.41

NEW
- Intro: a short cartoon opening with the new Blast Yard logo and theme sound (any key skips it; switch it off in Settings > Display).
- Early-access notice at start-up.
- Bug reports: press F8 anytime, describe the problem, and it sends us a screenshot, the game log and what was going on (mode, level, trial, story, enemies, map) so we can fix it fast. Works offline too - reports are sent once you are online.
- New logo, new game icon, and one clean font across the whole game.

IMPROVED
- Bots walk smoothly instead of stepping cell by cell (most noticeable on Easy).

Your profile and progress are kept.
